title: Metrics reloaded: recommendations for image analysis validation
mechanism: Problem fingerprint (target size and shape, reference quality, imbalance) drives metric choice; companion pitfalls paper doi:10.1038/s41592-023-02150-0.
adaptation: Write EL fingerprints: crack thin and noisy, inactive blob and rare, 24 classes with many absent in test; map to overlap + tolerance + per-component detection metrics; use as benchmark justification.
min_experiment: Arm: fill fingerprint for crack, inactive, structural classes. Kill: adopt only metrics it selects that we do not already report.
evidence: R: Delphi consensus framework; no empirical score gains.

alt_notes.adaptation: Write the EL fingerprint into the spec. Crack = tubular, 1-2 px, imprecise labels, so headline tolerance F1 / clDice / component recall and keep strict IoU secondary. Inactive = blobby and reliable, so IoU plus per-cell detection. Other classes = mIoU_rob with a fixed class list.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Re-score the existing 5 house seeds and the PF ensemble with the fingerprint metrics on clean-49. Decision: keep a metric in the headline only if its seed-to-seed SD is smaller than the gap between house and ensemble.
